targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  b.d AS time,
  a.class AS metric,
  SUM(b.value_eur) AS value
FROM derived.balances_eur b
JOIN core.assets a ON a.asset_code = b.asset
GROUP BY b.d, a.class
ORDER BY b.d;

SELECT
  40 AS crypto,
  40 AS actions,
  10 AS epargne,
  10 AS immo

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN sub.class = 'crypto'  THEN sub.total END) AS crypto,
  MAX(CASE WHEN sub.class = 'actions' THEN sub.total END) AS actions,
  MAX(CASE WHEN sub.class = 'epargne' THEN sub.total END) AS epargne,
  MAX(CASE WHEN sub.class = 'immo'    THEN sub.total END) AS immo
FROM (
  SELECT a.class, SUM(b.value_eur) AS total
  FROM derived.balances_eur b
  JOIN core.assets a ON a.asset_code = b.asset
  WHERE b.d = (SELECT MAX(d) FROM derived.balances_eur)
  GROUP BY a.class
) sub
SELECT NOW() AS time, SUM(value_eur) AS value FROM derived.balances_eur WHERE d = (SELECT MAX(d) FROM derived.balances_eur)
WITH months AS (SELECT d, SUM(value_eur) AS total FROM derived.balances_eur GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 2) SELECT NOW() AS time, MAX(total) - MIN(total) AS value FROM months
SELECT NOW() AS time, value FROM derived.returns_itd WHERE metric='twr' AND level='category' AND category='portfolio' AND as_of=(SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM derived.returns_itd)
SELECT NOW() AS time, value FROM derived.returns_itd WHERE metric='mwr' AND level='category' AND category='portfolio' AND as_of=(SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM derived.returns_itd)

SELECT
  NOW() AS time,
  SUM(
    CASE
      kind
      WHEN 'in' THEN amount_eur
      WHEN 'interest' THEN amount_eur
      WHEN 'out' THEN - amount_eur
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS value
FROM
  derived.flows_eur
WHERE
  EXTRACT(
    YEAR
    FROM
      d
  ) = EXTRACT(
    YEAR
    FROM
      CURRENT_DATE
  )

SELECT
  NOW() AS time,
  asset AS metric,
  value
FROM derived.returns_itd
WHERE metric = 'twr'
  AND level = 'asset'
  AND asset NOT IN ('ESPECES', 'COMPTE_COURANT')
  AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM derived.returns_itd)
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  b.d AS time,
  b.asset AS metric,
  SUM(b.value_eur) AS value
FROM derived.balances_eur b
JOIN core.assets a ON a.asset_code = b.asset
WHERE a.class = 'crypto'
GROUP BY b.d, b.asset
ORDER BY b.d

SELECT
  40 AS "BTC",
  25 AS "ADA",
  15 AS "NIGHT",
  5 AS "XRP",
  5 AS "INDY",
  4 AS "iUSD",
  4 AS "AVAX",
  2 AS "METERA"

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.asset = 'BTC'    THEN b.total END) AS "BTC",
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.asset = 'ADA'    THEN b.total END) AS "ADA",
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.asset = 'NIGHT'  THEN b.total END) AS "NIGHT",
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.asset = 'XRP'    THEN b.total END) AS "XRP",
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.asset = 'INDY'   THEN b.total END) AS "INDY",
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.asset = 'IUSD'   THEN b.total END) AS "IUSD",
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.asset = 'AVAX'   THEN b.total END) AS "AVAX",
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.asset = 'METERA' THEN b.total END) AS "METERA"
FROM (
  SELECT b.asset, SUM(b.value_eur) AS total
  FROM derived.balances_eur b
  JOIN core.assets a ON a.asset_code = b.asset
  WHERE b.d = (SELECT MAX(d) FROM derived.balances_eur)
    AND a.class = 'crypto'
  GROUP BY b.asset
) b;
SELECT NOW() AS time, SUM(b.value_eur) AS value FROM derived.balances_eur b JOIN core.assets a ON a.asset_code = b.asset WHERE b.d=(SELECT MAX(d) FROM derived.balances_eur) AND a.class='crypto'

  AND as_of = (SELECT MAX(as_of) FROM derived.returns_itd)

FROM (
  SELECT
    b.asset,
    SUM(b.value_eur) AS total

  JOIN core.assets a ON a.asset_code = b.asset
  WHERE b.d = (SELECT MAX(d) FROM derived.balances_eur)
    AND a.class = 'actions'
    AND b.asset NOT IN ('ESPECES')
